name: What's the Big Data

sources.title: Submit Your AI Tool — form fields, $599 Basic / $799 Featured packages, free-via-badge option, terms and FAQ

conditions: Free listing requires adding the 'Featured on Whatsthebigdata' badge (provided embed code) to your homepage or footer and emailing tool details + badge URL to the listed contact; verified and published in 2-3 business days
The badge must remain publicly visible for the listing to stay active
Paid path: Basic $599 or Featured $799 one-time (NSFW tools +$100), Stripe payment required before review
requirements: AI tools only — 'Get your AI tool featured'
Tool must be functional and accessible with a clear value proposition; no spam or misleading content
All submissions pass manual review (2-3 business days typical)
NSFW tools must be declared and cost +$100
Submitter must own or license all submitted content
Full refund if a paid tool is rejected
preparation: Tool name, URL, detailed description, key features
Logo URL (200x200 PNG/JPG recommended) and screenshot URLs (1200x800, one per line)
Contact name, contact email, company name
For the free route: ability to embed their badge on the homepage/footer and an email ready to send
workflow: Either: fill the form (tool info, media, contact) and pick Basic $599 or Featured $799, then pay via Stripe
Or for free: copy a badge embed code, place it on the homepage/footer, and email the listed address with tool details + the live badge URL
Wait for manual review (2-3 business days); an email confirms approval
Updates: contact support — minor updates free, major changes may re-review
watchFor: Form requires package selection to continue — the free path is email-based, not through the form
Payment is taken before review (full refund on rejection, so low risk)
Badge-based free listing dies if the badge is removed — they check for it
The site carries NSFW tool categories — assess brand adjacency before listing
countsAsLive: The tool appears on a public listing page in the /ai-tools/ directory after the review/verification email
unknowns: Whether the free (badge) listing renders identically to paid Basic listings
Whether outbound links are dofollow for free listings
